description: This file contains unit tests for the LDAPTestService class, testing LDAP connection scenarios including success, failure due to invalid credentials, syntax errors, host and port issues, and encryption configurations.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing LDAPService's connection functionalities under various scenarios.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run, including LDAP server configuration check.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Per-test setup to configure server and load data once.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures LDAP server settings, disables anonymous binding, sets size limit, and loads LDAP fixture data.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests successful LDAP connection with valid admin credentials.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection attempting anonymous bind, expects a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidUserName
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with invalid username, expects an InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidUserNameSyntax
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with malformed DN, expects a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPassword
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with incorrect password, expects an InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with unreachable host, expects a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with incorrect port, expects a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with SSL encryption on standard port, expects a ConnectionException.
